## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change enables. Link the roadmap item or issue when available.

## Validation

List checks and examples actually run, with results. Explain any checks not run.

## Decisions for review

Explain significant choices, alternatives considered, and tradeoffs. Identify
anything that would benefit from a walkthrough or discussion with the owner.

## Risks and limitations

Describe material limitations, compatibility changes, or security boundary changes. State when none apply.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This PR contains one focused roadmap item or an agreed smaller part.
- [ ] Formatting, lint, type, test, and packaging checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented behavior from planned capabilities.
- [ ] Relevant failure cases and security boundaries are covered.
- [ ] No secrets or generated artifacts are included.
- [ ] The complete diff, including new files, is available for owner review.
- [ ] Owner questions and requested changes are resolved; revisions are explained and checked.
- [ ] Merge waits for the project owner's explicit authorization of the current revision.
